September 16, 1971
2014-12-12T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/september-16-1971-54689

The trial of “Extinct” Awami League’s Chief Sheikh Mujibur Rahman has been finished in a secret martial tribunal, a Pak spokesman says.

PDP Nurul Amin tells PTI correspondent that he is going to West Pakistan for a visit. He will ask for budget for the flood-hit people and vandalism done by the “miscreants”.

Lt Gen Niazi visits Chittagong. Then he visits Rangamati. Elected MNA and Chakma king Raja Tridib Roy greets him.

For the last 15 days, Mukti Bahini eradicates Paki raiders from 63 square kilometres of Satkhira Mohkuma in Khulna district, a report of Kalantor newspaper says.
